question: In which of the following continents Mount Vinson is located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Antarctica**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Mount Vinson is located in Antarctica:
 
• Mount Vinson is the highest peak in Antarctica and is part of the Vinson Massif in the Ellsworth Mountains.
 
• The Vinson Massif is in the Sentinel Range, about 1,200 kilometres from the South Pole. 
 
• Height: Mount Vinson is 4,892 meters tall. 
 
• The Vinson Massif was discovered in 1958 by U.S. Navy aircraft. 
 
• The Vinson Massif was named after Carl G. Vinson, a U.S. congressman from Georgia who supported Antarctic exploration. 
 
• The first recorded ascent of Mount Vinson was in 1966 by an American team led by Nicholas Clinch
